# tools

```go
import "gorontalo/tools"
```

Package tools centralizes build\-time tooling for this module.

Tool binaries are pinned in go.mod via \`tool\` directives \(see \`go get \-tool\`\) so everyone runs the same versions. Each tool has its own file in this package holding its go:generate directive and usage notes \(for example, gomarkdoc.go for documentation generation\).
